name: The Gilded Cage
source:
Livvie, a Nightingale girl, longs for a life like her idol, the Phantom Diva. But reality is a gilded cage. After 100,000 marathon rereads, Livvie decides to take a page out of her favourite pulp fiction and heads "home." Except, things never go according to plots in the real world, do they?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250727153842/https://echanart03.itch.io/the-gilded-cage]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
身为“夜莺”女孩的莉薇，向往着偶像“魅影歌姬”那般的人生。然而现实却是一座华美的镀金鸟笼。在把最爱的通俗小说翻来覆去重读了十万遍之后，莉薇决定效仿书中的桥段，动身“回家”。只不过，现实世界里的事从来不会照着剧本走，不是吗？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250727153842/https://echanart03.itch.io/the-gilded-cage]itch.io[/url]]
